name: Compliance Officer
summary: Requires allow decisions to carry enforceable obligations like MFA and audit logging.
description: Ensures high-risk allows are never bare permits. Uses core.authorize structured obligations (require_mfa, audit_log) so calling systems can enforce additional controls before completing sensitive actions.

distinguished_from.how: Focuses on obligatory secondary controls and auditability, not the primary allow/deny rule engine design.
Works on authorization obligations generally, not AP document intake workflows.
